notes: San Francisco Bay Guardian, 1988 to 1994, 179 issues in the Internet Archive collection (7 for 1988, 57 for 1989, 58 for 1990, then 10 to 19 a year), read from its DjVu text. Hand-curated: news-word passages, article clusters and event passages were read and each finding's quote checked against the issue. People rule as in the dossier: no owners, staff, tenants, performers or customers.

coverage.remaining: 517 issues, 1998 to 2014: next 1998–2006 (122 issues), then 2008–2014 (395, lower value: those years were on the open web).
coverage.note: 179 issues; 91,622 numbered-address mentions on EAS streets, of which the advertisement filter marked 81,025 and kept 2,225 windows (1,502 rescued for an event word) in 1,849 address clusters. Read in full: the 119 passages of the news-word pass over the raw text, the 116 clusters of article prose, and the 71 event-word passages for places printed without a number. The 349 event-word clusters under the tighter filter were not read; in 1966 to 1976 they were nearly all advertisements. About 45 candidates were checked against the issue text; 38 were written and 3 dropped: the Elephant Walk fire of 2 December 1988 and the Board of Permit Appeals ruling on 379 17th Avenue as already on their pages, and The Sharper Image's headquarters because the article's address, 650 Broadway, is not one EAS holds and is doubtful. 35 findings, each quote found again in the issue's text. 28 resolved and published on 27 pages: 26 edited and 1 seeded, 260 McAllister Street, whose parcel already held one fact from the Tenderloin Times (tenderloin-times-0011, taken up and published with it after the passage was read again). 3 held as single facts on parcels with no page (425 14th, 1529 Haight, 105 Quint). 4 unresolved: 500 Eighth Street, which EAS joins to no parcel, and 343, 355 and 363 Golden Gate Avenue, the law college's demolished buildings, whose story is carried on the page for 333 Golden Gate. Framed as site history: 665 Bush (a one-storey building then on the site), 333 Golden Gate, 425 14th. Two findings come from the shops' own advertisements (Rough Trade at 1529 Haight, Good Vibrations at 1210 Valencia) and say so in a placement note. The audit flags 0 of 35.
